requirements.quote: In addition to meeting general BBS requirements, applicants are expected to have a strong foundation in the basic sciences (biology, chemistry, mathematics, etc.), fundamental understanding of molecular biology, and basic programming skills (e.g., R and Python).
In general, successful applicants will have completed undergraduate coursework in biology, chemistry at least through organic chemistry, physics, and calculus.
There are therefore no common courses required of all BBS applicants.
